name: River of Moonlight
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level druid/shaman 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of powdered moonstone)

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Area see text
Duration 2d4 rounds
Saving Throw Will half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a shimmering line of moonlight that you can shape as desired. The river of moonlight affects one 5-ft. square per caster level, and each square must be adjacent to the previous square, starting with you. The river of moonlight cannot extend beyond its maximum range. Living creatures in this path are transfixed by the luminous, sparkling moonlight, causing them to be fascinated for 2d4 rounds. Creatures that succeed on a Will save are fascinated for half the number of rounds.
